title: AI Legal Advisor
intro: Consult a virtual Indian advocate. Describe your situation — a contract you are about to sign, a dispute, or a case you want to file — and get advice grounded in the Constitution, Acts and sections.
heading: Ask an AI Lawyer Anything
description: Advice on contracts, disputes, court cases, your rights, and strategy — grounded in Indian law and Acts.

starters.rental: I'm about to sign a rental agreement — which clauses protect me and what should I avoid?
starters.loan: I want to file a case against someone who did not repay my loan. What are my options and chances?
starters.property: Which Constitution Articles and Acts apply to my property dispute with a neighbour?
